event: 2025 ILCA Senior Europeans and Open European Trophy
procedural_matters: The panel of the International Jury was composed in accordance with RRS N1.4(b). GER 223715 was represented by Mirja DOHLE. The race committee was represented by Zlatko Jakelic.
facts: The preparatory signal for race 6, 6th attempt was the black flag.
The race committee identified GER 223715 as being in the triangle formed by the ends of the starting line and the first mark during the last minute before her starting signal.
The race committee signaled a general recall in race 6, on it’s 6th attempt.
The race committee neither displayed the sail number of GER 223715’s on the board on the water, nor on Telegram.
GER 223715 sailed the race, after the general recall.
The race committee scored GER 223715 as BFD after watching a video on shore.
GER 223715 did not provide any evidence that the race committee made an improper action or an improper omission.
conclusions: The race committee is entitled to correct a scoring error when she determines from its own records or observations that it has scored a boat incorrectly, and also to make the corrected scores available to competitors, as per RRS 90.3(c).
There was neither an improper action nor improper omission of the race committee. Therefore, the requirements for redress in RRS 61.4(b)(1) are not met.
